paragraphs: Locally owned • Serving Greater Baton Rouge
Local weed control and fertilization designed for South Louisiana lawns. Month-to-month plans start at $39.
Locally owned lawn-treatment specialists who understand South Louisiana turf.
Step 1 of 2 • Property details
Enter the service address and we’ll measure your lawn to prepare an accurate, no-obligation estimate.
Firefighter-owned • Locally operated
Grow Green is a local lawn-treatment company providing expert weed control and fertilization throughout Baton Rouge, Prairieville, Gonzales, Denham Springs, and surrounding communities.

Our year-round liquid program is tailored to Bermuda, St. Augustine, Centipede, and Zoysia lawns —helping control weeds, support healthier roots, improve color, and address insects and common lawn diseases.
From your first estimate to every scheduled visit, Grow Green keeps lawn care clear, convenient, and pressure-free.
Send us your service address. We’ll measure the lawn and provide clear, no-obligation pricing for the recommended program.
Review your recommended service, approve the estimate online, and our office will confirm and schedule your first visit.
A trained technician treats your lawn for its current seasonal needs and documents the conditions we find during the visit.
We return about every six weeks with treatments adjusted for Louisiana’s changing seasons and your lawn’s ongoing needs.
Request a free estimate with no obligation and no long-term contract.
See what local customers say about our technicians, communication, and lawn-treatment service.
Services built for South Louisiana
Start with our year-round lawn program or add targeted care for fire ants, flower beds, ornamental plants, compacted soil, and biting pests.
Year-round treatments designed for Baton Rouge-area turf—targeting weeds, supporting stronger roots, and providing seasonal nutrition.
Scheduled treatments target visible mounds and hidden colonies to help reduce fire-ant activity throughout your lawn.
Landscape weed control
Pre-emergent and targeted weed control helps keep landscape beds cleaner with less time spent pulling weeds by hand.
Ornamental plant care
Scheduled nutrition, insect control, and disease treatments help protect ornamental trees and shrubs through Louisiana’s changing seasons.
Improve water movement, root development, and soil conditions with core aeration or a targeted liquid soil treatment.
Targeted outdoor treatments help reduce mosquitoes, fleas, and ticks around the areas where your family spends time outside.
Tell us what you’re seeing, and our local team will recommend the right starting point.
Popular service areas
Why homeowners choose Grow Green
Grow Green is a firefighter-owned, local lawn-treatment company. We focus on the weeds, turf, soil, trees, and shrubs found right here in South Louisiana.
Our signature lawn program

Our liquid lawn program combines weed prevention, targeted weed control, balanced nutrition, and seasonal monitoring for South Louisiana lawns. The treatment changes with the season—because your lawn does, too.
The year-round treatment rhythm
8 professional lawn treatments each year
Visits are scheduled roughly every six weeks. Each round is adjusted for current weather, weed pressure, turf growth, and the needs of your lawn—not the same mix sprayed eight times.
Seasonal pre-emergent and post-emergent weed control helps stop new weeds before they start and targets existing weeds when conditions allow.
Balanced liquid fertilizer and micronutrients support healthier roots, improved color, and denser growth without pushing the lawn harder than the season allows.
Your technician watches turf response, weed activity, insects, and signs of disease so treatments and recommendations match what is happening in your yard.
Available separately based on your property’s needs
Free local lawn estimate
Tell us what you’re seeing and what you want to improve. Our local team will review your property and recommend a straightforward plan—with clear pricing and no pressure.
Start online, or call or text (225) 461-3199 if you would rather talk to a real local person.
Serving Ascension, Baton Rouge, Livingston & nearby areas
